compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode: UPDATE

## What
Update plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md Phase A (Initialization) to set the GitHub Actions repo variable vars.SPRINT_SESSION_ID when sprint execution begins. This enables the sprint-story-review.yml workflow to identify the session branch.

## Where to add (Phase A, after WORKTREE_TRACKING:start comment block)
Add a bash block:
  _SESSION_BRANCH=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo 'unknown')
  _GH_REPO=$(gh repo view --json nameWithOwner --jq .nameWithOwner 2>/dev/null || true)
  if [[ -n "$_GH_REPO" ]]; then
    gh api --method PATCH "repos/$_GH_REPO/actions/variables/SPRINT_SESSION_ID" \
        -f value="$_SESSION_BRANCH" 2>/dev/null || \
    gh api --method POST "repos/$_GH_REPO/actions/variables" \
        -f name="SPRINT_SESSION_ID" -f value="$_SESSION_BRANCH" 2>/dev/null || true
  fi

Rationale:
- PATCH first (idempotent update for existing variable); POST as fallback for initial creation
- || true so failure (no GH auth, fork repo, no actions:write permission) does not block sprint execution
- gh repo view resolves the repo without hard-coding

## Files to modify
- plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md — Phase A section, after WORKTREE_TRACKING:start block
